insights.safety_car_rate: Physical Safety Car deployed in 3 out of the last 4 races (75% probability)
insights.turn_1_hazard: Longest drag race to Turn 1 (890m) causing recurrent first-lap collisions
insights.altitude_factor: 2,240m altitude produces 22% less air resistance; teams run maximum wing angles yet achieve Monza-like top speeds (>350 km/h). Turbochargers spin faster to compensate for thin air, stressing cooling packages.
insights.checo_historical: P3 in 2021 and 2022. High home crowd pressure; aggressive start behavior.
